# Task taxonomy & selection guide (updated 2026-10-11)

## Evidence note — read first

Recommendations below are categorical labels (`best` / `good` / `ok` / `avoid`) from each model entry `task_fit` (analysis), never invented numeric scores.
Context windows, max outputs and prices are UNKNOWN in this guide by design — read the exact per-model FACT values in the provider sections (retrieved 2026-10-11).
Prices change frequently — re-check the pricing pages listed in `sources-update` before cost decisions.

## Cost-saving rules per agent role

Director: cheapest tier with fit best/good for the triage step; escalate only hard plans to strong-reasoning. Manager: balanced default; strong-reasoning only for hard decomposition and final review.
Worker: cheapest model that can do the subtask. Auditor: strong-reasoning but a different family from the producer; never the same model that did the work.
